notes: The responsive results come from the final strengthened rerun at 2026-10-10T01:44:57.971Z, not the earlier weaker layout run.
Final HTML changes after functional checks only bump voice asset query versions from 1 to 2 for cache invalidation.
Sample playback tests mute the audio element; no microphone or physical device access.
Remote voice, chat recording and transport are simulated. Local WAV playback is real.
No production implementation, cross-machine audio, echo cancellation, real recording, network performance or platform audio was tested.
Existing screenshot source/assets are unchanged; the remote regression verifies the screenshot entry still exists, not a complete screenshot functional regression.
Early background-timer and wrong CDP page-target failures were resolved before isolated reruns; unrelated active-tab console output is excluded.
